{"consolidated_memory":"worker/scheduler/cron.py: Three missed-run issues in the scheduler

All three occasions involved the same symptom (missed run in the scheduler, signaled by a slot with no execution record) in the same Python background jobs component, with repro method of advancing the fake clock across the schedule, and test coverage in tests/worker/test_cron.py. However, each had a distinct trigger, root cause, and fix:

OCCASION 1 [2026-03-20, c023-e1]
Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
Root cause: two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
Fix: wrapped both writes in one transaction (PR #2238 on branch fix/missed-run-2)
Result: 88 duplicate rows a day stopped being written

OCCASION 2 [2026-03-24, c023-e2]
Trigger: accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
Root cause: a race in lazy initialisation
Fix: guarded the init with a double-checked lock (PR #3953 on branch fix/missed-run-3)
Result: the nightly rollup matched the source counts for 10 days running

OCCASION 3 [2026-06-16, c023-e3]
Trigger: when the input list came in empty
Root cause: floating point rounding in the money path
Fix: moved the arithmetic to integer minor units (PR #4611 on branch fix/missed-run-4)
Result: the job finished in 47 minutes instead of 6 hours"}
